title: Powell Industries announces second quarter fiscal 2026 results
publisher: Powell Industries, Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Fiscal Q2 revenue was USD 296.6 million, gross margin 29.6%, new orders USD 490 million and backlog USD 1.8 billion; the period included a data-center award above USD 75 million.
summary: The SEC-filed release confirms continued order growth, a roughly 1.7x book-to-bill ratio, improving sequential revenue and margin, and the subsequent award of Powell's largest-ever data-center order above USD 400 million.
